About me

I turn ideas into working web products.

I’m a full-stack web developer focused on building clean, responsive and practical applications. I enjoy working across the complete development flow — from interface design and frontend interactions to backend APIs, authentication, databases and deployment.

What I bring

I’m comfortable taking ownership of a feature end-to-end: planning the user flow, building the interface, connecting it to backend logic, storing data properly and testing the final experience. ZiqTech is an example of that full process in one project.

Full-stack development Responsive UI API integration Authentication Database design Deployment

Featured project

ZiqTech — Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform.

A technology e-commerce application built from scratch with customer shopping flows, product management, authentication, order processing, invoice generation and a PostgreSQL-backed backend.

More than a storefront.

ZiqTech includes customer and admin authentication, dynamic product variants, stock-aware cart logic, wishlist flows, checkout, order tracking, invoices, customer profiles and a dedicated admin dashboard.

What I built in ZiqTech

End-to-end features across the full customer journey.

The project goes beyond a landing page. It includes customer-facing flows, backend logic, data persistence and administrative tools.

How I worked on it

I iterated on the project feature by feature: building the interface, testing flows locally, connecting backend routes, migrating persistent data to PostgreSQL, fixing bugs, versioning changes with Git and deploying working updates to Render.
